column1: # tools/toolchain-census.tsv -- the adjudication half of `R1-pub-0b`'s census.
# `tools/tccensus.py` derives the POPULATION from two instruments and checks
# this table against it in both directions.  It IMPORTS `tools/isacensus.py`
# for the join machinery rather than restating it; the reasons are in its
# docstring and they are measured, not preferences.
#   r2c  one RECORDED TOOLCHAIN FINDING -- every `TC-*` id `SPEC.md` carries,
#        § 14 and one, `TC-h`, that exists only in § 17's blank list.
#   r2t  one TOOLCHAIN RELEASE -- every `CONFIG_RSDK_*` line in
#        `config/rlxfw-sdk.config`, selected or not.  A release this project
#        can name and does not have is a `declared` row with a cite.
# ROUTES.  These are NOT the ISA census's four and must not be read across.
#   r1  量 at the DESK -- a toolchain program was executed, or an artefact it
#       produced was executed, and the result measured.  On this axis the
#       strongest route costs no power, which is why § 6's scope answer comes
#   r2  量 on an ARTEFACT -- a shipped binary or a device reading was READ and
#       a toolchain property inferred.  Nothing was executed.
#   r3  讀 vendor material -- a Makefile, a wrapper log, a `.config`, source,
#       or a vendor patch says so.  Nothing was executed and nothing was read
#   (all three `.` is route 4 -- no evidence of any class)
#   p   ⓟ PUBLIC PRIOR ART.  The ISA census has no such column and the
#       difference is structural: `R1-pub`'s claim is *this is not in public
#       data*, which holds for the die and largely does not for the toolchain.
#       `p=y` means a public source STATES this row's finding -- not that the
#       material is public, and not that someone could derive it.  Every `y`
#       carries a `pub=` cite.  The column is a LOWER bound: it was
#       adjudicated only where a concrete public source was read.
#   mx  a declared disagreement with `SPEC.md`'s own V mark.  `L12` computes
#       the strongest route a mark supports (量 -> 1, 讀 -> 2, 文 -> 3,
#       推/— -> 4) and requires anything stronger to be declared here.  量
#       2026-09-12: eighteen rows need it and fifteen are ONE shape -- V=讀
#       on a row whose evidence is a desk EXECUTION, several of whose value
#       cells open with the character 量.  `SPEC.md`'s mark legend is written
#       for readings about the DEVICE; on this axis "a compiler was run" has
# `subj` -- tc (the build side: a toolchain, a drop, the build system), die
# (this silicon), or both.  The step table asks every row for this in those
# Tab separated.  No `|` in any cell: the note column is rendered into a
# markdown table and `spec-check`'s C8 counts cells by pipe.
